statement: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ), Monotone a → BddAbove (range a) → Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 (⨆ n, a n))
script:
# name: ra-monotone-convergence-test
# technique: test a claim no recipe certifies, at instances Sage evaluates exactly or by intervals
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.RealAnalysis.Sequences.monotone_convergence file "ra-monotone-convergence-test.sage"
# description: Sage computes the limits of increasing bounded sequences and checks they bound the terms (the supremum)
SEED = 0  # the instances are listed, no sampling
R = RealIntervalField(128)
def B(b):
    return QQ(1 if bool(b) else 0)
RI = RealIntervalField(256)
def O(values, lhs, rhs, rel='==', edge=False):
    # symbolic values (π, e, logs, limits Sage computed) are compared by 256-bit intervals; rationals exactly
    if any(hasattr(v, 'parent') and v.parent() is SR for v in (lhs, rhs)):
        lhs, rhs = RI(lhs), RI(rhs)
    return oracle_instance(*values, lhs=lhs, rhs=rhs, relation=rel, edge=edge)
n = var('n')
instances = []
for a, ex, edge in [('(fun n : ℕ => 1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))', 1 - 1 / (n + 1), False),
                    ('(fun n : ℕ => (1 + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ (n + 1))', (1 + 1 / (n + 1)) ** (n + 1), False),
                    ('(fun _ : ℕ => (3 : ℝ))', SR(3), True)]:
    L = limit(ex, n=oo)
    sup_ok = all(R(ex.subs(n=j)) <= R(L) for j in range(0, 200))
    instances.append(O([a, '‹_›', '‹_›'], B(sup_ok), QQ(1), edge=edge))

goal.text: Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 (⨆ n, a n))
